post.title: Photoshop wants $22.99 a month. Retouch kept the 5% that got used.
post.caption: Three fresh grudges: a Mac photo editor with only the Photoshop tools that got used, a menu bar world clock without Dato's price, and an IDM-style download manager with no licence nags.

segments.quote: I pay for Photoshop and use maybe 5% of it.

cues.say: Photoshop wants twenty-two ninety-nine a month

cues.cap: for every tool, used or not.

cues.say: and use maybe five percent of it.
[quick] So: Retouch. Just the five percent.

segments.quote: A free alternative to Dato ($7.99), World Clock Pro ($5.99)
segments.gripe: Paying extra for a second clock.

cues.cap: Paying extra for a second clock.

cues.say: [sarcastic] A free alternative to Dato, seven ninety-nine,

cues.cap: So: MultiClock Free. Two time zones.
cues.say: [quick] So: MultiClock Free. Two time zones.

segments.quote: I honestly never liked the licence nags.
segments.gripe: Internet Download Manager nags for a licence.

cues.cap: Internet Download Manager nags for a licence.
All built out of pure spite.
